DESCRIPTION.Common Locations.model_specs_readme_path: Path to the model specifications help document.
DESCRIPTION.Routers: Router entries keyed by user-defined names. Add any number of router entries, each with its own model specifications, template and template password. Any router can be selected as either source or destination during migration.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>: Paths for an individual router entry. All required fields are strings; ~ expands to the user home directory. Router entries are not permanently designated as source or destination. Migration transfers matching logical config_fields labels between the selected routers.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.specs: Path to this router model's JSON specifications, including encryption, archive format and named config_fields used for conversion.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.password: Path to the password file used to decode this router model's reference template. Physical router passwords are entered separately when required.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template: Path to this router model's reference encrypted backup. When selected as a migration destination, this template provides the base configuration.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_decoded: Decoded .tar.gz archive of this router's reference template.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_decoded_d: Directory containing the extracted reference template.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_edited: Rebuilt .tar.gz archive of the edited reference template.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_edited_di: Directory containing the edited reference template.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_encoded: Encrypted backup output from template editing and encoding.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.original: Path to this physical router's backup. Used when this router is selected as the migration source, with its actual router password.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_decoded: Decoded .tar.gz archive of this router's physical backup when selected as the migration source.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_decoded_: Directory containing the extracted physical source backup.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_edited: Reserved output path for an edited source .tar.gz archive.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_edited_d: Directory containing the edited source configuration settings to transfer to the selected destination.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_converte: Decoded .tar.gz destination archive, initially prepared from this router's template when selected as the migration destination and rebuilt during encoding.
Directory containing the prepared destination template with the converted source settings applied.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_encoded: Encrypted backup generated when this router is selected as the migration destination, using the destination router password supplied during encoding.
